resources.purpose: Reject stale client effects across page instances and authenticated sessions.
resources.retention: Memory only for the page instance; invalidated on hide and discarded on unload or owner change.
resources.deletion: Discarded synchronously with page runtime invalidation; no new persistent copy exists.
resources.export: Not exported because it is transient authorization-control metadata, not a new user fact.
resources.encryption: Uses the existing authenticated session in memory; no additional at-rest representation is created.
resources.minorPolicyRef: No new collection; inherits the existing authenticated-account policy.
resources.backupDisposition: Not backed up; transient page memory only.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: Not applicable to transient control metadata; canonical account facts remain with the existing owner.
resources.correctionSemantics: Session changes invalidate the owner instead of mutating it in place.

resources.purpose: Remember a preference, study constraint or note that the authenticated user explicitly asks Companion to reuse.
resources.source: Direct user entry on the Companion memory management page only.
resources.retention: Retained while the account exists until the user deletes the item or clears all long-term Companion memories.
resources.deletion: A single delete or clear removes the selected rows; account erasure removes every row for the user.
resources.export: Included with stable ID, category, content, source, revision and timestamps in the personal-data export.
resources.encryption: Uses the existing PostgreSQL encrypted storage and transport controls for account-private data.
resources.residency: Same approved application database boundary as the existing Companion account data.
resources.minorPolicyRef: No inference or public sharing; the authenticated account owner explicitly supplies and controls each item.
resources.backupDisposition: Follows the existing encrypted database backup lifecycle and is removed from live data by user deletion or account erasure.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: No product legal hold is introduced by this feature; any overriding statutory hold remains outside this release unit.
resources.correctionSemantics: Exact-state update requires the current revision; deletion is a hard user-visible removal rather than a hidden active copy.

resources.purpose: Record whether the user permits active long-term Companion memories to be injected into answers.
resources.source: Authenticated user toggle on the Companion memory management page.
resources.retention: Retained while the account exists or until account erasure; disabling changes use, not retention of memory items.
resources.deletion: Account erasure removes the setting; absence is interpreted as enabled with no memory items until the user acts.
resources.export: Included in the personal-data export with enabled state and update time.
resources.encryption: Uses the existing PostgreSQL encrypted storage and transport controls for account-private data.
resources.residency: Same approved application database boundary as the existing Companion account data.
resources.minorPolicyRef: No vendor request receives memory items when this setting is disabled.
resources.backupDisposition: Follows the existing encrypted database backup lifecycle.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: No product legal hold is introduced by this preference setting.
resources.correctionSemantics: The authenticated user can set either exact boolean state at any time.

resources.purpose: Keep a small page-context-scoped conversation window so follow-up questions remain understandable.
resources.source: Successful authenticated Companion questions and answers only.
resources.retention: At most four turns per authorized page context, each expiring two hours after creation.
resources.deletion: The user can clear all live turns immediately; expiry cleanup and account erasure also remove them.
resources.export: All still-retained mini-program and iLink short-term turns are included in the personal-data export.
resources.encryption: Uses the existing PostgreSQL encrypted storage and transport controls for account-private data.
resources.residency: Same approved application database boundary as the existing Companion and iLink data.
resources.minorPolicyRef: No automatic durable extraction; expiry and manual clear apply equally to all authenticated accounts.
resources.backupDisposition: Expired or cleared live rows are not restored into the application from backups.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: No product legal hold is introduced for transient conversation context.
resources.correctionSemantics: Turns are not edited; the user clears them and starts a new context.

resources.purpose: Record that the authenticated user considers one evidence-backed coach judgment inaccurate and requests re-verification without editing the judgment itself.
resources.source: Explicit action on the same-user error-pattern evidence view.
resources.retention: Retained with the account until resolved by later evidence or account erasure.
resources.deletion: Account erasure removes all requests; a resolved request remains as an append-only audit fact while the account exists.
resources.export: Included with request ID, referenced profile and pattern, state, note and timestamps.
resources.encryption: Uses the existing PostgreSQL encrypted storage and transport controls for account-private data.
resources.residency: Same approved application database boundary as learning and Companion data.
resources.minorPolicyRef: Only the authenticated account owner can create or read the request; it never auto-edits an ability fact.
resources.backupDisposition: Follows the existing encrypted application backup lifecycle.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: No product legal hold is introduced by this release.
resources.correctionSemantics: Requests are append-only versions; new evidence resolves or supersedes a request rather than rewriting the referenced learning fact.

resources.purpose: Recover one grounded Feynman teach-back session and its answer-free user-facing state across app interruptions.
resources.source: Authenticated user explanation, compiled teaching package identities, isolated provider outputs and the user's transfer answer.
resources.retention: Retained with the learning account to preserve the learning evidence chain until account erasure.
resources.deletion: Account erasure removes session versions; no public sharing or model training copy is created.
resources.export: Included with session state, user explanation, safe questions, user transfer answer, provider audit metadata and timestamps; server-only answers remain internal authority.
resources.encryption: Uses existing PostgreSQL encrypted storage and TLS controls; provider payload follows configured minimized external-processing controls.
resources.residency: Application database plus the configured approved AI provider boundary for the two isolated calls.
resources.minorPolicyRef: Provider inputs are minimized and physically separated; no answer or method authority enters the student call.
resources.backupDisposition: Follows the existing encrypted learning-data backup lifecycle.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: No product legal hold is introduced by this release.
resources.correctionSemantics: Session versions are append-only; stale revisions are rejected and retries use stable command identities.

resources.purpose: Keep one uploaded teacher question book recoverable while projecting current per-question match progress without duplicating match truth.
resources.source: Authenticated user's resolved upload, current confirmed exam segmentation revision and current content-match heads.
resources.retention: Retained with the account until the user deletes the book or erases the account.
resources.deletion: The existing private-material deletion worker removes object storage, expires and erases recognition and match payloads, deletes private search copies and marks source artifacts deleted.
resources.export: Markdown source export is available per book and the existing account export includes source material, recognition, match and private-source records.
resources.encryption: Uses existing encrypted application database, TLS and private object-storage controls.
resources.residency: Same approved private upload, application database and object-storage boundary as external ingestion and private knowledge.
resources.minorPolicyRef: Only the authenticated account owner can create, read, export or delete a book; uploaded content is not made public or used for model training.
resources.backupDisposition: Deleted application records are not restored into the live product from backups; backup expiry follows the existing encrypted backup lifecycle.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: No product legal hold is introduced by this release.
resources.correctionSemantics: Question progress is not edited in the book row; users confirm matches through the existing append-only match command, while book deletion removes the private source.

resources.purpose: Prove which current confirmed question-book matches supplied one existing Xingce practice session without copying private book content or creating another attempt authority.
resources.source: Owned private question-book source version, current confirmed match heads, current content heads, active delivery-eligible Xingce releases and the existing plan task session.
resources.retention: Opaque lineage identities remain with the immutable learning attempt until account erasure; no book title, OCR text or raw upload is copied into the runtime bundle.
resources.deletion: Deleting the private book removes its object, recognition, match and private-source rows. The existing attempt retains only opaque version references and canonical public question/content identities needed for learning-fact audit; account erasure removes both sides.
resources.export: The existing learning-data export may include the session and opaque source lineage; private source content is exported only while the source still exists.
resources.encryption: Uses existing encrypted PostgreSQL and TLS controls; this command performs no external AI or provider dispatch.
resources.residency: Application database only, inside the existing private-source and task-runtime boundary.
resources.minorPolicyRef: Only the same authenticated account can launch or inspect the session; no private upload content is shared or used for model training.
resources.backupDisposition: Follows the existing encrypted learning-data backup lifecycle and account-erasure restore exclusion.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: No product legal hold is introduced by this release.
resources.correctionSemantics: A session freezes the source identities it actually consumed. Later match or content-head changes do not rewrite the attempt; a new compatible plan task is required for another launch.

resources.purpose: Associate visual matching evidence with exactly one recognized question on a multi-question page without storing another image asset.
resources.source: Trusted server-rendered page bytes already supplied to an approved local recognition adapter plus sealed exam-segmentation coordinates.
resources.retention: Normalized box, source page hash and derived hashes are embedded in the immutable recognition candidate revision and follow its retention.
resources.deletion: Deletion of the private source or account erasure removes the recognition revision and therefore all embedded region evidence; no crop object exists to delete separately.
resources.export: Private recognition export may include geometry and hashes; crop bytes and provider data URLs are never persisted or exported.
resources.encryption: Uses existing encrypted application storage and TLS controls. Page bytes remain transient process memory only.
resources.residency: Application process memory during derivation and the existing private recognition-revision store for hashes and geometry.
resources.minorPolicyRef: Only same-account recognition and matching paths may consume the evidence; no public media asset or training copy is created.
resources.backupDisposition: Follows immutable recognition-revision backup retention and account-erasure restore exclusion.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: No product legal hold is introduced by this release.
resources.correctionSemantics: Text correction preserves the sealed geometry-derived evidence; reprocessing produces a new immutable recognition revision and fresh evidence.

resources.purpose: Record whether one authenticated learner currently permits minimized Xingce cause evidence to be sent to explicitly disclosed external AI processors.
resources.source: The learner's explicit accepted or withdrawn action against policy xingce-cause-external-ai@v1 on the reflection or data-and-privacy surface.
resources.retention: Append-only consent events and dispatch receipts remain with the account for authorization audit and are removed from the live product by account erasure; processor-side retention remains processor-specific and may be unknown.
resources.deletion: Account erasure removes local consent events and local receipts. For user-consent processors whose remote deletion support is unverified, the deletion manifest records remote_deletion_unavailable_disclosed instead of claiming remote erasure.
resources.export: Personal-data export includes consent action, policy version and timestamp plus each external processing receipt's processor identity, authorization mode, consent event reference, training-use disclosure and retention disclosure.
resources.encryption: Consent and receipts use the existing encrypted PostgreSQL boundary and TLS; provider keys remain root-only runtime secrets and never enter these records.
resources.residency: Consent events and receipts remain in the application database; minimized cause evidence may be processed by the three disclosed external routes whose provider-side residency is disclosed as verified or unknown.
resources.minorPolicyRef: The product is not intended for children; no sensitive identity fields are permitted in the external payload, and consent does not authorize any use outside the declared cause-analysis purpose.
resources.backupDisposition: Deleted consent and receipt records are not restored into the live account; encrypted backup expiry follows the existing account-erasure restore-exclusion policy.
resources.legalHoldSemantics: No new legal hold is introduced; processor-side legal obligations remain outside the product's deletion control and are disclosed as unknown where not verified.
resources.correctionSemantics: Consent history is never edited. A learner changes the current state by appending withdrawn or accepted against the active policy; a new policy version requires a fresh acceptance.
